answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a small refundable deposit before it earns anything, like nectar offered only to bees that stay at the flower. The stake is slashed if peers catch fake identities, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs real money instead of just a zephyr of compute. Over a long horizon, reputation accrues only to identities with a costly, verifiable history of useful work, making mass fakery unprofitable while honest newcomers can still join by staking once.
